intro: Teton Web today, and a decade of operator history before it — the working ground beneath the strategy.

roles.title: Founder & Lead Developer
bullets: Founded and lead Teton Web, an AI-orchestration and web development consultancy delivering platforms, internal tooling, and rollout guidance for clients across industrial equipment, global nonprofit, insurance brokerage, and inventor-network markets. Serve as trusted technical advisor and de facto CTO across their AI, platform, and web decisions.

Architected and productionized multi-agent systems that run as everyday force multipliers — Slack-resident agents, cross-device automation, Linear task pipelines, and routine-maximization workflows. They double as concrete reference points when I'm explaining maturity and rollout risk to technical buyers.

Pioneered Cursor + Composer workflows that coordinate parallel sub-agents for issue execution and branch management. Public demos serve as proof points for what mature AI-assisted development can actually ship in production.

Led high-context client engagements — major design-system proposal work, international platform and catalog delivery, and alumni-platform facilitation — operating as a peer to senior engineering and product leadership while connecting architecture, tradeoffs, and business outcomes.

Building an all-in-one small-business SaaS platform spanning website/CMS/CRM, realtime workflows, and AI. Own proposals, contracts, financials, multi-tenant architecture, and product direction end-to-end.

roles.title: Owner / Operator
bullets: Built and managed hundreds of websites across Intuit Homestead, Wix, WordPress, Shopify, and Next.js — from brochure sites to e-commerce and custom web applications.
Handled ongoing website operations including redesigns, migrations, domains, DNS, hosting coordination, content updates, storefront configuration, troubleshooting, and client training.
Operated a technology services business for small businesses and homes, resolving thousands of support cases across Windows, macOS, Android, iOS, networking, cloud, and dedicated-server environments.

Designed and maintained 50+ workstation business networks, Google Workspace profiles, IP printing, file sharing, backup/data-retention policies, phone systems, security administration, and paperless iPad workflows that saved hundreds of hours annually.
